mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.gross_pay), 0) AS gross_pay, COALESCE(SUM(p.taxable_pay), 0) AS taxable_pay, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.amount) FROM gw_payroll_item i JOIN gw_payroll p2 ON p2.pay_id = i.pay_id WHERE p2.user_id = #{userId} AND p2.pay_month LIKE #{year} || '-%' AND p2.status_cd IN ('CONFIRMED','PAID') AND i.code_val IN ('INCOME_TAX','LOCAL_INCOME_TAX')), 0) AS income_tax, COUNT(*) AS months FROM gw_payroll p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.pay_month LIKE #{year} || '-%' AND p.status_cd IN ('CONFIRMED','PAID')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_year_end_tax (user_id, tax_year, gross_pay, taxable_pay, paid_tax, income_deduction, tax_credit, determined_tax, settled_tax, status_cd, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taxYear}, #{grossPay}, #{taxablePay}, #{paidTax}, #{incomeDeduction}, #{taxCredit}, #{determinedTax}, #{settledTax}, COALESCE(#{statusCd},'DRAFT'), #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_year_end_tax SET gross_pay = #{grossPay}, taxable_pay = #{taxablePay}, paid_tax = #{paidTax}, income_deduction = #{incomeDeduction}, tax_credit = #{taxCredit}, determined_tax = #{determinedTax}, settled_tax = #{settledTax}, status_cd = #{statusCd}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE yet_id = #{yetId}
mapper.select: SELECT y.*, u.name AS user_name, d.dept_nm FROM gw_year_end_tax y JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = y.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE y.user_id = #{userId} AND y.tax_year = #{taxYear}

SELECT y.*, u.name AS user_name, d.dept_nm FROM gw_year_end_tax y JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = y.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE y.tax_year = #{taxYear} ORDER BY d.dept_nm, u.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_severance (user_id, hire_date, leave_date, service_days, avg_monthly_wage, avg_daily_wage, severance_pay, severance_tax, net_pay, status_cd, memo, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{hireDate}, #{leaveDate}, #{serviceDays}, #{avgMonthlyWage}, #{avgDailyWage}, #{severancePay}, #{severanceTax}, #{netPay}, COALESCE(#{statusCd},'DRAFT'), #{memo}, #{createdBy})
